selection: Choose development candidates by MITweet validation log loss, with macro-F1, balanced accuracy and calibration reported. Topic holdout is opened only after candidate selection is frozen.
grouping: New MITweet partitions use transitive lexical duplicate components, not topic-as-author proxies. Author/thread identities are unavailable; no author-disjoint claim. Topic stress split contains entire preselected topics and linked duplicates.
limitations: Automated screening of human facet annotations, not direct overall-US gold labels.
12–150 words admitted to retain meaningful short tweets.
Historical synthetic roles preserved; no protected historical holdout or diagnostic enters fitting.
All original datasets and earlier metrics remain separate and unchanged.
